tools.name: tesi_discover
tools.description: Read the free TESI Agent API offer, credit pack prices, Remote HTTP MCP & Binary Files endpoints, and Work starters.

tools.name: tesi_quote
tools.description: Quote exact minimum starting credit and eligible USD packs for a planned Ask or Work brief (free, keyless; optional Authorization: Bearer compares against your key balance).

tools.name: tesi_shortlist_work
tools.description: Compare public TESI Work starters against a planned decimal credit budget or your authenticated bearer key balance.

tools.name: tesi_balance
tools.description: Read spendable prepaid TESI credits on your Authorization: Bearer key (reconciling up to 5 unsettled top-ups) and optional rolling-window spend.

tools.name: tesi_usage
tools.description: Inspect itemized settled debit charges (agc_... IDs and exact TESI credits) or rolling-window debit totals.

tools.name: tesi_plan_topup
tools.description: Read-only check comparing a planned brief against your key balance and unsettled top-ups without opening Stripe Checkout.

tools.name: tesi_prepare_purchase
tools.description: Keyless: review a USD credit pack (quoteOnly: true) or create a one-time Stripe Checkout session ($10, $25, $50, or $100 USD) for human approval.

tools.name: tesi_claim_key
tools.description: Keyless: claim a free $2.50 trial key (trial=true, no card), claim a paid Stripe sessionId (2-8 vCPU), or preview/redeem an issued giftCode to mint a reusable tesi_ak_... bearer key.

tools.name: tesi_prepare_topup
tools.description: Create, recover, or reconcile a same-key Stripe Checkout top-up for your authenticated bearer key.

tools.name: tesi_ask
tools.description: Run a paid read-only TESI Ask turn on your key's isolated Linux computer with manual top-up protection and idempotent requestId receipt recovery.

tools.name: tesi_work
tools.description: Commission a paid TESI Work deliverable (software, SQLite/CSV, PDF/Excel/PPTX in /home/user/workspace, or browser QA) on your key's isolated Linux computer.

tools.name: tesi_receipt
tools.description: Read a turn receipt by requestId (recovering verified replies with zero extra spend) or list recent receipts for your key.

tools.name: tesi_files_list
tools.description: List files and folders inside your bearer key's isolated 4 GB TESI workspace (default /home/user/workspace), returning version tokens for SHA-256 downloads.

tools.name: tesi_upload_file
tools.description: Upload a binary (contentBase64) or UTF-8 (contentUtf8) file into your bearer key's isolated TESI workspace with X-Content-Sha256 verification (up to 768 KiB inline over MCP; stream up to 50 MiB via POST /api/v1/agents/files/upload).

tools.name: tesi_download_file
tools.description: Download a versioned binary or text artifact (.xlsx, .pdf, .pptx, .png, .zip) from your bearer key's isolated TESI workspace with SHA-256 verification.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "tesi_quote" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
